_about: Liss's emotion tags -> face blendshape weights (docs/kb/art/characters/act1_npcs.md §2.6). A pair is [L, R]; a scalar sets both sides of a paired shape. Her rest brow_down 0.08 (a resting scowl: the straight brows slant down toward the nose) is added to every row. Her asymmetry is a wry, left-sided smile: mouth_smile L = R x 1.3, with nose_sneer_L 0.10 added once the smile passes 0.3 (Rhen's crooked smile is on the right; theirs mirror each other). Blend 0.10 s, the fastest in the party, with 5% overshoot. Tags: game/data/dialogue/emotions.json. Read by the hero stage for the M3-CHR-03 review shots; the sequencer.json face_poses entry is Cinematics'.

head_notes.neutral: the head forward and down 4 degrees, as if looking at something in her hands
head_notes.laugh: loud: the head forward, not back
head_notes.grief: Ch15, telling her father about Tobin: the widest stretch of any table; tear layer
head_notes.cold: Ch6: 'He put the fire out once it had finished'
